insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Base Sum Insured + Booster+ + Safeguard/Safeguard+ + ReAssure+/ReAssureX as per Policy Schedule/Variant)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: You can select any room without a limit on room rent, giving you full flexibility. This means there is no daily cap on room rent that could reduce your claim amount.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: Additional Sum Insured activates after the first claim and remains for life if the policy is renewed continuously. This provides unlimited extra coverage beyond the base Sum Insured.

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage...”
great.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 12 to 36 months depending on the variant chosen. The best option offers a 12-month waiting, which is better than the usual market standard.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected) of continuous coverage...”
great.reference: Section 5.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02)
great.explanation: Certain illnesses or procedures are excluded for 12 to 24 months depending on the variant. The best variant offers a 12-month waiting period, which is better than the standard 24 months.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident...”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents which are covered immediately. This is the standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: ...for 60 days before the date of admission...
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered if hospitalization is claimed. This meets the market standard for pre-hospitalization cover.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered following a hospitalization claim. This is considered a good post-hospitalization benefit.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments, up to Base Sum Insured for the list as specified below:”
good.explanation: Specified modern treatments are covered up to the base Sum Insured amount. This coverage is standard but may have sub-limits.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home which in normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home provided that...”
good.explanation: Treatment at home that normally requires hospital care is covered under certain conditions. This is a common and useful benefit.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment are placed as Annexure I.”
bad.explanation: Many consumables and non-payable items are excluded or included in room/procedure charges, causing out-of-pocket expenses unless you buy additional covers. This can increase your costs.

bad.name: No NCB
bad.quote: “Cumulative Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium.”
bad.reference: Definition 2.1.8 (definition only; no benefit statement found)
bad.explanation: Although the term 'Cumulative Bonus' is defined, no actual renewal bonus or no-claim bonus benefit is stated. This means you likely do not get extra Sum Insured for claim-free years.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “4.1.16. Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear for every claim, Rest we will pay.”
bad.explanation: Co-payment is described and offered as an option, but the default co-pay percentage is not explicitly stated. This makes it unclear if you pay any co-pay by default.

unclear.name: Restore Benefit
unclear.quote: “Sum Insured will be utilized as per following sequence in event of any claim: 1. Base Sum Insured 2. Booster+ Sum Insured 3. Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured 4. ReAssure+/ReAssureX”
unclear.explanation: The policy explains the order of Sum Insured usage but does not clearly confirm if a classic restore benefit (replenishing base SI within the same year) exists beyond ReAssure. Clarification is needed.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: “Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY. As list of network hospitals is dynamic, for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.”
unclear.explanation: The policy states cashless claims are available at network hospitals but does not specify how many hospitals are in the network. This makes it unclear how extensive the network is.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
